name: pulse
description: Pulse is a realtime team messenger.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @pulse/api build && pnpm --filter @pulse/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @pulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @pulse/api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @pulse/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @pulse/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @pulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @pulse/api test && pnpm --filter @pulse/web test
